title: CICS Dance Duo — 1st Runner-Up
description: CICS MADE IT HAPPEN! A huge congratulations to our incredible CICS Dance Duo for taking home the title of 1st Runner-Up! Their powerful moves, amazing chemistry, and confidence on stage brought the CICS spirit to life. Every step, every beat, and every performance showed their hard work and dedication. They danced with passion, performed with pride, and made the College of Information and Computing Sciences proud. Your talent. Your passion. Your moment. Photo credits: The Josephian Messenger.
